mechanics.claim: Spider Form / Human Form is a self-buff toggle with no damage, healing, or cost of its own; the passive bonuses it scales come from Spider Queen (passive), not this R entry.
mechanics.quote: '''Elise''' switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Spider Form}}.

mechanics.claim: Switching to Spider Form summons all stored Spiderlings and heals them to full, switching to Human Form stores active Spiderlings; this affects whether the Spiderling swarm is present to deal damage.
mechanics.quote: she summons all stored ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' and {{tip|heals}} them to full health

mechanics.claim: Transformations do not count as ability activations for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Casting Spider Form during a basic attack windup lets that attack benefit from Spider Queen bonus damage/healing while keeping human attack range instead of using a projectile.
mechanics.quote: '''Elise''' will perform a ''Spider Form'' basic attack that benefits from the bonus damage and healing from {{ai|Spider Queen|Elise}}, but remain at ''Human Form'' basic attack range, despite not using a projectile

mechanics.claim: Spider Form and Human Form toggles have separate cooldowns.
mechanics.quote: ''Spider Form'' and ''Human Form'' have separate cooldowns.
